subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Proud
solution:
The correct answer is: **Haughty**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Proud"** generally refers to a feeling of deep pleasure or satisfaction derived from one's own achievements, qualities, or possessions. (गर्वित)

 
 
• **Example:** She felt proud of her daughter's academic success.
 
 
 
• **"Haughty"** refers to someone who is arrogantly superior and disdainful, often synonymous with excessive pride or conceit. (घमंडी)
 
 
• **Example:** The haughty businessman refused to acknowledge the contributions of his team.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of "Proud" in this context is **"Haughty."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Haughty**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hyper** (अत्यधिक सक्रिय): Excessively energetic or active.

 
 
• **Example:** The children became hyper after eating too much candy.
 
 
 
• **Sad** (उदास): Feeling or showing sorrow or unhappiness.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt sad after hearing the bad news.
 
 
 
• **Happy** (खुश): Feeling or showing pleasure and contentment.
 
 
• **Example:** He was happy with the results of his hard work.
